description.value: Hainle Vineyards Estate Winery is BC's 8th estate winery, founded in 1972, and holds the distinction of being both the birthplace of North American Icewine and Canada's first certified organic winery (1988). The estate produces naturally handcrafted, chemical-free wines from its own Peachland vineyard using winemaking traditions dating to the mid-1800s. Touring cyclists can visit the wine shop for tastings and in-store purchases, and the property also offers a Bed & Breakfast for those looking to extend their stay in the Okanagan.
